## Touring History

Noah Kahan's live career scaled dramatically alongside the success of *Stick Season*. What began as
support slots and small venue headline dates grew into sold-out arena and amphitheater tours as the album
found a global audience.

::: {.timeline}

::: {.entry}
<span class="year">Early Years</span> — Plays clubs and small theaters, opening for other artists while
building a fanbase.
:::

::: {.entry}
<span class="year">2022–2023</span> — Headlines the **Stick Season Tour**, growing from theaters to larger
venues as the album's popularity surges.
:::

::: {.entry}
<span class="year">2023</span> — Performs at major festivals, including sets that introduce his folk-pop
sound to broader festival audiences.
:::

::: {.entry}
<span class="year">2024</span> — Headlines the **We'll All Be Here Forever Tour**, playing arenas and
stadiums across North America, the UK, and Europe.
:::

:::

## Awards & Recognition

- **Grammy Award nomination** — Best New Artist (2024 ceremony, recognizing 2023 eligibility period)
- **Billboard and streaming chart success** — *Stick Season* spent extended time on major album and
  streaming charts, with the title track becoming a multi-platinum single
- **iHeartRadio and other industry nominations** recognizing his breakout year as a folk-pop crossover artist

::: {.callout-note}
Chart positions, certifications, and award outcomes are frequently updated by industry bodies; consult
Grammy.com or Billboard.com for the most current, authoritative figures.
:::
